camel_example: aliyun polardb CreateDataProcessJob --region cn-hangzhou --SourcePath '/images' --DestinationPath testdb --SourceType PolarFS --SourceId 'pfs-123456' --ProcessingMode Full --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DestinationType PolarDB --DestinationId 'pc-test123456' --TemplateId 'tpl-123456'
description_en: Creates a task to process data in PolarFS based on a specified template and write the data to a PolarDB database
description_zh: 创建任务，将 PolarFS 中的数据按指定模板处理并写入 PolarDB 数据库
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-data-process-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-type PolarFS --source-id pfs-123456 --source-path /images --destination-type PolarDB --destination-id pc-test123456 --destination-path testdb --template-id tpl-123456 --processing-mode Full --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataProcessJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the task resides
parameters.help_zh: 任务所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the data processing task
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The data source type. Currently, only PolarFS is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，当前仅支持 PolarFS
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarFS instance that serves as the data source
parameters.help_zh: 作为数据源的 PolarFS 实例 ID
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The source data path in PolarFS. An empty string indicates the default path
parameters.help_zh: PolarFS 中的源数据路径；空字符串表示默认路径
parameters.name: source_path

parameters.help_en: The additional configuration for the data source in JSON string format. You can leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 数据源的额外配置，使用 JSON 字符串；当前可留空
parameters.name: source_config

parameters.help_en: The destination type. Currently, only PolarDB is supported
parameters.help_zh: 目标类型，当前仅支持 PolarDB
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination PolarDB cluster
parameters.help_zh: 目标 PolarDB 集群 ID
parameters.name: destination_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination database
parameters.name: destination_path

parameters.help_en: The JSON string for the destination database connection configuration, which includes the account and password
parameters.help_zh: 目标数据库连接配置的 JSON 字符串，包含 Account 和 Password
parameters.name: destination_config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task template used to process data
parameters.help_zh: 用于处理数据的任务模板 ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the model used for feature extraction
parameters.help_zh: 抽取特征时使用的模型名称
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The processing mode. Valid values: Full, Incremental, and Both
parameters.help_zh: 处理方式，可选 Full、Incremental 或 Both
parameters.name: processing_mode

JobId.description_en: The ID of the created data processing task
JobId.description_zh: 创建的数据处理任务 ID
